Experience Resurgence on the all-new Zodiac map during Weekend Two of the Modern Warfare 4 Beta.

Outlast every opposing squad to secure the win.

template.label: Maps
template.description: Multiplayer maps with scenic art, compass maps, wordmarks, banners, galleries, game modes, and community reactions.

attributes.label: Scenic
attributes.description: Lobby scene. WebP at the game-file size, native aspect. Replaces the list icon when present.

attributes.label: Icon
attributes.description: Compatibility copy of scenic for clients that still read icon. Left unchanged when a map has no scenic.

attributes.label: Compass
attributes.description: Overhead compass map. WebP, native square size. Replaces tacmap.

attributes.label: Compass half
attributes.description: Compass at half width and half height.

attributes.label: Tacmap
attributes.description: Compatibility copy of the full compass for clients that still read tacmap. Left unchanged when a map has no compass.

attributes.label: Wordmark
attributes.description: Title wordmark. WebP at the decoded size.

attributes.label: Wordmark half
attributes.description: Wordmark at half width and half height.

attributes.label: Banner
attributes.description: Lobby banner. WebP at the decoded size.

attributes.label: Gallery
attributes.description: Array of { id, lg, sm } 16:9 WebP stills. lg max 1920×1080, sm max 640×360.

attributes.label: Game modes
attributes.description: Array of mode slugs. Gunfight maps are gun-fight only. Ground War maps are ground-war only.
